subject: learning/javascript-free-installation
statement: Pyxis installation no longer installs a JavaScript review runtime: init, update, doctor, and preflight require Git but do not require Node or npm, run npm ci, or maintain a runtime dependency cache. Installer rollback covers the remaining repository and hook changes without a dependency-bundle step.
intent: Keep installation and repair independent of the removed browser annotation runtime.
rationale: The removed runtime was the consumer of the Node and npm installation requirements; retaining those requirements would leave a hidden dependency after removing the feature.
fit_criterion: Installer and preflight tests pass without Node or npm on the subprocess PATH; rollback, update, and doctor tests cover the remaining stages.

provenance.note: Records the installation consequences of removing Lavish and its exclusive dependencies.
